title: Threat Pattern: Part-Time Job Tasks and Courier / Delivery Phishing Scams
content:
Employment task fraud and delivery notification deception exploit everyday economic activities and online ordering behavior.

1. Part-Time Task Scams (YouTube / Hotel Rating / Trading Tasks):
- Recruitment: Unsolicited WhatsApp, SMS, or Telegram messages offering work-from-home employment paying high daily sums (e.g., Rs. 2,000 to Rs. 8,000/day) for simple actions like liking YouTube videos, rating Google Maps locations, or reviewing hotels.
- Initial Payouts: Victims complete 2-3 trivial tasks and receive modest sums (Rs. 150-500) directly into their bank accounts to manufacture trust.
- Escalation to Prepaid Tasks: Victims are added to Telegram VIP groups and instructed to deposit capital to unlock 'crypto arbitrage' or 'merchant rating' tasks with promised 30-50% returns. Once large deposits are made, withdrawals are blocked and victims are pressured for tax or clearance fees.

2. Courier Delivery Notification Scams:
- SMS messages allege that a postal package cannot be dispatched due to an incomplete delivery address or minor unpaid customs duty.
- Links redirect to counterfeit courier web pages (spoofing India Post, FedEx, DHL, USPS) requiring address entry and card payment details.
- The card details and subsequent OTP are used by fraudsters to execute fraudulent high-value debits.
